verdict.rationale: Adyen documents in-person acceptance through its Terminal API and Adyen-supplied PCI-certified terminals, and explicitly supports contactless payments via Tap to Pay on iPhone and other compatible devices. The evidence never names chip/EMV insertion or Apple Pay / Google Pay; it says only that 'global and local payment methods' are accepted, and the test card covers 'different CVMs'. missing for 10: explicit documentation of chip (EMV insert) acceptance, explicit Apple Pay / Google Pay mobile-wallet support on terminals, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can accept chip, contactless, and mobile-wallet (Apple Pay / Google Pay) payments in person

citations.quote: With our Tap to Pay on iPhone solution you can accept contactless in-person payments using an iPhone as the payment interface, and process these payments on the Adyen payments platform.
Turn compatible smartphones or tablets into Tap to Pay checkouts. No extra hardware required.
The Adyen Terminal API lets you make payments, issue refunds, collect shopper information, and perform other shopper-terminal interactions using a payment terminal supplied by Adyen.
Enables you to accept global and local payment methods.
Get started fast with a full range of PCI PTS 6 certified terminals.
